name: Gershala Nightwhisper
summary: In Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper studies the harm magical corruption brings to elves. He fears the path taken by the high elves of Quel'Thalas, and examines cursed aquatic naga and demonic satyr for signs of what corruption does to mind and body.

sections.title: Study of Transformation
sections.body: From Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper looks beyond Darkshore's coastal troubles to the danger he sees in Quel'Thalas. The high elves embrace perilous arcane practices and call themselves blood elves. Their example troubles him, so he seeks to learn what unchecked magic does to body and spirit. He sends seasoned Alliance adventurers into the submerged halls of Blackfathom Deeps to gather corrupted brain stems from the naga and satyr who dwell there.

sections.title: An Antidote to Ruin
sections.body: The naga and satyr brain stems interest Gershala because both races were once night elves. They yielded to Queen Azshara and demonic bargains, and became what they are now. Gershala studies the marks that millennia of demonic and abyssal energies left on their nervous systems. He hopes to find warnings or safeguards that could spare other elven kin a similar monstrous deformity.

faq.answer: Gershala Nightwhisper is found in Auberdine, the main Alliance port town on Darkshore's coast.

faq.q: Why does Gershala want naga and satyr brain stems?
faq.answer: Gershala studies corrupted brain stems to learn how magical and demonic transformation changed the anatomy of former night elves. Naga and satyr were once elves, and their bodies bear the marks of corruption.

faq.q: What does Gershala hope to accomplish with his research?
faq.answer: Gershala hopes his research can keep the blood elves from becoming evil and monstrously deformed through dangerous reliance on fel and unchecked arcane power.

faq.q: Where are the specimens Gershala needs located?
faq.answer: Gershala directs adventurers to Blackfathom Deeps, an ancient submerged temple ruin on the coast of Ashenvale where naga and satyr dwell.

angles.text: For night elves, Gershala's grim inquiries recall the ancient Sundering and the terrible cost of magical addiction, which reshaped their brethren into horrors.
For the Alliance, Gershala is a patron who sends expeditions into the hazards of Blackfathom Deeps, where they can gather valuable arcane knowledge.
